CommunityApplications.Profile:
Apps by Jamison Fitz. Currently home to **Fliparr** — Tinder-style swiping for Radarr's movie recommendations. Radarr's Discover tab is a wall of text; Fliparr turns it into a deck of cards, one film per phone screen with poster, ratings, genres, synopsis, and trailer. Swipe right to add a movie to your library, monitored and searching; swipe left to write a permanent Import List Exclusion so it never comes back. Undo up to 50 deep. Open source (GPL-3.0), self-hosted, LAN-only — it talks to your Radarr and nothing else.
Support: https://github.com/Jamisonfitz/fliparr/issues
